description: StormR is an R package from UMR AMAP for extracting cyclone tracks and reconstructing wind exposure over a user-selected area. It generates wind-speed and wind-direction fields and summary measures including peak sustained wind, power dissipation and time above chosen wind thresholds. Inputs are storm tracks, locations and wind-field settings; outputs are spatial or point-level exposure estimates for the storms in the supplied record. Geographic and time coverage inherit the track source. GPL-3.0 source, CRAN and conda installation routes, function documentation and a JOSS paper are public. A limitation is that wind fields are reconstructed from the available track and intensity observations, so site-level gusts and local terrain effects are not measured directly. StormR can prepare cyclone exposure layers for transmission, road or coastal-asset simulations. The related catalogue IBTrACS data record is a track source, while StormR is a processing package. No track archive, wind raster or R package was downloaded.
name: StormR cyclone wind-field generator
